label: JUDGMENT
source: JUDGMENT: engineering judgment fixed by the coordinator in docs/PLAN_M5_M8.md, section 'M8 uncertainty' (2026-10-07). These 1-sigma widths are NOT published values; NASA's NESC F-16 package gives no uncertainty for its aerodynamic tables.
rationale: Damping (rotary) derivatives are less certain than static tables, so their sigma is doubled (0.10 vs 0.05).
distribution: independent normal N(1, sigma) per multiplier (Monte Carlo)
coverage_note: per group: box half-width k_g * sigma with k_g = sqrt(chi2inv(coverage, d)), d = number of parameters in the group, so the box contains the group's 99 % joint ellipsoid; the full box is the product of the group boxes
multiplier_note: Each parameter is an AeroScale multiplier (vital.aircraft.f16.config) on ONE term of the NASA aero model about the MRC (35 % MAC); it is not a CG-derivative uncertainty (ADR R2-5). Parameter Cn_r is the AeroScale field Cnr_table (the name Cn_r is used by tests/M6/tAeroScale.m as an unknown name; see reports/fragments/uq/NOTES.md).
